m: Cut the pork into big chunks. Rub with the cumin, oregano, smoked paprika and 2 tsp salt.
Slow cooker: onion and garlic in the bottom, pork on top, juice of half the limes and the stock powder dissolved in ½ cup water. 8 hours on low or 5 on high. (Oven: covered, 160°C for 3½ hours.)
Shred the pork with two forks and stir it through the juices.
Crisp it up: spread the pork on a tray with a ladle of juices and grill on high for 5 to 8 minutes until the edges are crunchy. Or fry in batches in a hot pan.
Lime crema: sour cream with the juice of the remaining limes and a pinch of salt. Slaw: shred the cabbage thin and toss with a little lime and salt.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan. Load with pork, slaw, crema, jalapeños, avocado and coriander.
l: Burrito bowl it: pork over rice and slaw, crema on the side. Keep the avo whole until the day.
g: Corn tortillas instead of flour (check they're 100% corn). Check the stock powder.
